note: Harmonic alchemy: marks that need both halves of a person. Giving alone will not make one, and neither will writing alone. Conditions are checked on this device; nothing here is sent anywhere.

conditions.entryDays: distinct days written in the journal
conditions.gave: seeds planted with a gift, of any project
conditions.gaveCategory: a seed planted with a gift to a project in this Giveth category
conditions.gaveUnseen: a seed that was the first a project ever received
conditions.phase: a plant that has reached this many days of care
conditions.sun: how much a linked Giveth address tends the commons, 0 to 5

models.name: Resilient Earth
models.line: You funded the ground and you tended yourself. Both, or neither.

models.name: First Light
models.line: You gave to someone nobody had given to yet, and you kept writing.

models.name: Answered
models.line: You wrote to a stranger about why. A stranger wrote back.

models.name: Deep Roots
models.line: One thing held for nine days, and a gift sent outward in the same season.

models.name: Open Hands
models.line: You gave to a person you know and to a person you will never meet.

models.name: Spoken And Sent
models.line: You said it out loud, and then you did something about it.

models.name: Clear Water
models.line: You gave where the water is, and you kept a week of your own.

models.name: The Commons
models.line: You tend the commons on chain and you tend yourself off it.

models.name: Named And Kept
models.line: You gave a season a name, and you gave a stranger a reason.

models.name: Said Aloud
models.line: You said where you are going, and you helped someone else get there.

models.name: The Whole Circle
models.line: Planted, written, given, answered. The loop closed once, and it can close again.

models.name: Taught By Light
models.line: A picture, a voice, a gift and thirty days. Nothing here can be bought.
